_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to `application-answers.json` (gitignored) and fill in your own values.
THE ONE HARD RULE: the form filler may only put values from this file into a real
employer's form. If a field asks something whose value here is null, it MUST leave the
field blank and report it. Never invent an answer — a guessed notice period or salary is
a false statement sent to a real company under your name.
Blank beats wrong. Skip beats invent.
Two salary figures on purpose: domestic and international differ by ~40x, and sending
the wrong one is an instant auto-reject. See `which_to_use` below.

compensation.which_to_use: Use the LPA figure for Indian employers (Indian ATS ask in LPA). Use the USD/year figure for remote/international employers. Decide from the employer's country; if unclear, use the India figure.
compensation.numeric_field_rule: PROVEN 2026-07-29: LinkedIn Easy Apply numeric inputs REJECT words and decimals-as-LPA. '8.4' fails client-side validation and silently blocks the Next button. In a NUMERIC field answer the annual figure (e.g. 840000 for India, 30000 international). Only use the LPA form where the label itself says LPA and the field accepts text. IMPORTANT: once a failing numeric field validates, LinkedIn reveals additional questions that were hidden behind it — always re-snapshot after a correction.

availability.notice_period_note: Use notice_period_days ('0') in any NUMERIC field. PROVEN 2026-07-29: LinkedIn rejects the word 'Immediate' in a number input. The word form is only for free-text fields or dropdowns.
availability.work_type_preference: Remote, hybrid or on-site — all acceptable

eligibility.work_authorization_india: Citizen — authorised to work, no sponsorship required

experience.total_professional_years_note: Fresher. Substantial project and open-source work, but no salaried role — answer 0 or 'Fresher' honestly.
experience.notable: One or two sentences of your strongest, verifiable, quantified work.

NEEDS_ANSWERS._note: null = the filler leaves the field BLANK and appends the field name to output/apply-log/needs-answer.md. Fill these in as they come up so the robot stops stopping. Every null here is a form the robot may have to abandon.

_derivation_rule: Exactly ONE derivation is permitted, because it is a fact and not a guess:
how_did_you_hear_about_us -> 'LinkedIn', when the role was discovered through LinkedIn.
Nothing else may be derived. Everything else is a lookup or a blank.
